main.description: Wait for a record written to a PDS to reach this bobbin instance, then report what happened to it.

uri.description: AT-URI of the record that was written.

cid.description: CID of the revision that was written, as returned by createRecord, putRecord or applyWrites. Omit it only when awaiting a delete, which has no CID. any other responds with whatever revision of the record settles first.

status.description: What bobbin did with the record.

cid.description: CID of the revision this result is about.

reason.description: Why a rejected record will not appear.

detail.description: Opaque error message which can be more detailed than the reason.

errors.name: NotSettled
errors.description: The record had not reached the appview before the wait ran out

errors.name: Overloaded
errors.description: Too many callers are already waiting, retry later or poll the record instead
